lead_raw_text:
The structure of SrCaHg₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives Ca and Sr centers a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each, while Hg centers show 11- or 12-neighbor environments involving Ca, Hg, and Sr. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Ca, Hg, and Sr coordination polyhedra, as well as corner- and edge-sharing between 11- and 12-vertex Hg polyhedra.
